segments.text: Hey there! My name is Larry. I am an English teacher with PSOL and TUIL certificates, which means I'm qualified to teach kids, young professionals, and even adults.
Besides teaching, I do public speaking for five years now. During my spare time, I do vlogging and video editing.
I studied five languages so I know how to help you widen your vocabulary.
I can dance, act, and sing too, making sure that all my lessons are interesting, interactive, and informative.
So come and book a class with me. See you!
